_comment: Publish consent for the character borrow (/odekake_done) and the size of the friend list it feeds (/client_state_read kind friend_game). The borrow hands one account's chara build to another account, so it needs an opt-IN that the client cannot give it: FriendInfo.cs is six fields (OdekakeDataID/FriendID/PlayerName/Dan/IsUsable/CharaType), FriendGameData.Save (FriendGameData.cs:21-26) is never called, GameDataManager.IsOdekakeEnable (GameDataManager.cs:960-963) is a global event flag that only hides the My Room Friend page, and no request in MFG.GameRequest posts a publish. So consent is server state, recorded per account on its own profile document (profile.odekake_publish, handlers/utils.ts odekakePublished) and granted from this file. publish_default: false = every account is private, which is the safe reading: 'everyone lends to everyone' is what this gate exists to stop. true|all|open = the deployment lends every real account to every other account. none|off|closed = nobody lends, whatever any record says. publish_accounts: refids (16-char card ids, case-insensitive) or mids, one per entry, that publish under the opt-in default. Override per deployment with VFG_ODEKAKE_PUBLISH="off|all|REFID,mid" in config.ini or the environment; a refid or mid listed there publishes, and off|none revokes everyone including an operator record. max_lenders: how many rows one account's friend_game may hold. A row's OdekakeDataID is a borrow grant this server issues onto the viewer's own profile (profile.odekake_grants) and odekake_done resolves the posted number only against that table - never against a player_id. This deployment (private WebGL rebuild LAN, 2026-11-01): publish_default=true, so the friend borrow works between every real account; set it false for strict per-account opt-in, or VFG_ODEKAKE_PUBLISH=off to revoke everyone including operator records.
